POSTNUPTIAL AGREEMENT

This Postnuptial Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of September 8, 2026, between Oluwaseun Adebayo-Reid and Marguerite Adebayo-Reid, who are married to each other and who are referred to in this Agreement as the "Spouses" and individually as a "Spouse."

RECITALS

A. The Spouses were married on June 14, 2014, in Hennepin County, Minnesota, and remain married as of the date of this Agreement.

B. During the marriage, each Spouse has acquired property, and each Spouse expects to acquire further property, some by gift and inheritance and some by earnings and effort.

C. The Spouses wish to define their respective property rights during the marriage and in the event of dissolution or death, to settle disputes that have arisen between them concerning the characterization of the Meadowlark Street property and Oluwaseun's interest in Adebayo Orthopaedics PLLC, and to continue their marriage.

D. Each Spouse acknowledges the confidential and fiduciary relationship between spouses and the heightened duty of disclosure and fair dealing that relationship imposes on a postnuptial agreement.

1. CONSIDERATION

In consideration of the mutual promises in this Agreement, the settlement of the disputes described in Recital C, the transfers described in Section 3, and the Spouses' continued cohabitation and marriage, each Spouse agrees to the terms below. Each Spouse acknowledges that this consideration is adequate.

2. FULL AND FAIR DISCLOSURE

2.1 Disclosure. Each Spouse has made a full and fair disclosure to the other of all assets and liabilities, and of the income of each Spouse, as set out on Schedule A (Oluwaseun) and Schedule B (Marguerite). The schedules state the nature, approximate value, and encumbrances of each asset, and the amount of each debt.

2.2 Acknowledgment. Each Spouse has read both schedules, has had a reasonable opportunity to ask questions and to obtain further information and appraisals, and waives any further disclosure. Each Spouse acknowledges that the terms of this Agreement are fair and reasonable in light of the disclosure made, and that no material asset, debt, or source of income has been concealed.

3. PROPERTY CHARACTERIZATION AND TRANSMUTATION

3.1 Separate Property. The property listed on Schedule A is the separate property of Oluwaseun, and the property listed on Schedule B is the separate property of Marguerite, together in each case with all appreciation, income, rents, and proceeds of that property, whether the appreciation results from market forces or from the effort of either Spouse.

3.2 Marital Property. Property acquired by either Spouse after the date of this Agreement, other than by gift or inheritance and other than the proceeds of separate property, is marital property, to be divided equally on dissolution.

3.3 Transmutation. The Spouses intend that this Agreement transmute the Meadowlark Street residence, currently titled jointly, into the separate property of Marguerite, and that it transmute Oluwaseun's 40% membership interest in Adebayo Orthopaedics PLLC, currently characterized as marital property, into the separate property of Oluwaseun. Each Spouse conveys to the other all right, title, and interest necessary to give effect to this Section 3.3, and shall execute any deed, assignment, or other instrument reasonably requested to record the transmutation.

3.4 No Further Transmutation. No property is transmuted or recharacterized except in a writing signed by both Spouses that expressly states an intent to change the character of the property. Commingling, joint titling, use of separate funds for a marital purpose, and payment of a separate debt from marital funds do not by themselves transmute or recharacterize any property.

4. SPOUSAL SUPPORT

4.1 Waiver. Each Spouse waives any claim to alimony, spousal support, or spousal maintenance from the other, whether temporary or permanent, in any proceeding for dissolution or legal separation, except as provided in Section 4.2.

4.2 Limited Support. If a dissolution proceeding is commenced more than ten (10) years after the date of this Agreement, the Spouse with the lower average gross income over the three (3) calendar years preceding the filing is entitled to support of $6,500 per month for a duration of one month for every three months of marriage after the date of this Agreement, and no longer.

4.3 Acknowledgment. Each Spouse acknowledges that a court may decline to enforce a support waiver that would leave a Spouse dependent on public assistance, and that Section 4.1 is severable from the remainder of this Agreement.

5. RIGHTS AT DEATH

Each Spouse waives the right to elect against the other's will, to a spousal or family allowance, to homestead, and to any statutory share, except as provided in a will, revocable trust, or beneficiary designation executed after the date of this Agreement.

6. INDEPENDENT COUNSEL AND VOLUNTARY EXECUTION

6.1 Counsel. Oluwaseun is represented by Farida Benkirane of Benkirane Family Law LLC. Marguerite is represented by Tobias Lindqvist of Lindqvist & Hale PA. Each Spouse has had the advice of that Spouse's own independent counsel and a reasonable period, not less than fourteen (14) days, to review this Agreement before signing.

6.2 Voluntariness. Each Spouse enters this Agreement voluntarily, with full knowledge of its terms and effect, and not under duress, coercion, fraud, or undue influence. Neither Spouse has been given a deadline that would prevent deliberate consideration.

7. GENERAL

7.1 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Minnesota.

7.2 Amendment and Revocation. This Agreement may be amended or revoked only by a writing signed and acknowledged by both Spouses with the same formality as this Agreement.

7.3 Severability. If any provision is held unenforceable, the remainder continues in effect.

7.4 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, with Schedule A and Schedule B, is the entire agreement of the Spouses concerning its subject matter.

The Spouses have signed this Agreement on the date first written above.

/s/ Oluwaseun Adebayo-Reid
Oluwaseun Adebayo-Reid

/s/ Marguerite Adebayo-Reid
Marguerite Adebayo-Reid
